// logic, control flow, and Java-idiom conversions (visitors,
// builders, enums-with-methods) are left to a follow-up pass.

package jscomp

import (
	"github.com/paullepoulpe/jsgo/internal/jscomp"
	"github.com/paullepoulpe/jsgo/internal/rhino"
	"github.com/paullepoulpe/jsgo/internal/diag"
)

// Diagnostic codes discovered in the Java source.
// Add the matching entries to internal/diag/diag.go.
//
//   JSC_USELESS_CODE (warning)

// Checks for non side effecting statements such as
// 
// <pre>
// var s = "this string is "
//         "continued on the next line but you forgot the +";
// x == foo();  // should that be '='?
// foo();;  // probably just a stray-semicolon. Doesn't hurt to check though
// </pre>
// 
// and generates warnings.
type CheckSideEffects struct {
	Report bool
	ProblemNodes []*rhino.Node
	NoSideEffectExterns map[string]struct{}
	Compiler *Compiler
	ProtectSideEffectFreeCode bool
	// Whether the synthetic extern for JSCOMPILER_PRESERVE has been injected
	PreserveFunctionInjected bool
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckSideEffects.java:29
func NewCheckSideEffects(compiler *Compiler, report bool, protectSideEffectFreeCode bool) *CheckSideEffects {
	c := &CheckSideEffects{}
	c.compiler = compiler
	c.report = report
	c.protectSideEffectFreeCode = protectSideEffectFreeCode
	return c
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckSideEffects.java:36
func (c *CheckSideEffects) Process(externs *rhino.Node, root *rhino.Node) {
	NodeTraversal.Traverse(compiler, externs, NewGetNoSideEffectExterns())
	NodeTraversal.Traverse(compiler, root, c)
	if protectSideEffectFreeCode {
		ProtectSideEffects()
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckSideEffects.java:53
func (c *CheckSideEffects) Visit(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) {
	if n.IsEmpty() || n.IsComma() {
		return
	}
	if parent == nil {
		return
	}
	if n.IsExprResult() || n.IsBlock() {
		return
	}
	if n.IsQualifiedName() && n.GetJSDocInfo() != nil {
		return
	}
	if n.IsStringLit() && n.GetParent().IsExprResult() && n.GetGrandparent().IsScript() && n.GetSourceFileName().StartsWith(AbstractCompiler.RUNTIME_LIB_DIR) && n.GetString().StartsWith("require ") {
		return
	}
	isResultUsed := NodeUtil.IsExpressionResultUsed(n)
	isSimpleOp := NodeUtil.IsSimpleOperator(n) || n.IsGetProp() || n.IsGetElem()
	if !isResultUsed && !n.IsVoid() {
		if isSimpleOp || !t.GetCompiler().GetAstAnalyzer().MayHaveSideEffects(n) {
			if report {
				msg := "This code lacks side-effects. Is there a bug?"
				if n.IsStringLit() || n.IsTemplateLit() {
					msg = "Is there a missing '+' on the previous line?"
				} else if isSimpleOp {
					msg = "The result of the '" + Ascii.ToLowerCase(n.GetToken().ToString()) + "' operator is not being used."
				}
				t.Report(n, USELESS_CODE_ERROR, msg)
			}
			if !NodeUtil.IsStatement(n) {
				problemNodes.Add(n)
			}
		} else if n.IsCall() && n.GetFirstChild().IsGetProp() || n.GetFirstChild().IsName() || n.GetFirstChild().IsStringLit() {
			qname := n.GetFirstChild().GetQualifiedName()
			isDefinedInSrc := false
			if qname != nil {
				if n.GetFirstChild().IsGetProp() {
					rootNameNode := NodeUtil.GetRootOfQualifiedName(n.GetFirstChild())
					isDefinedInSrc = rootNameNode != nil && rootNameNode.IsName() && t.GetScope().GetVar(rootNameNode.GetString()) != nil
				} else {
					isDefinedInSrc = t.GetScope().GetVar(qname) != nil
				}
			}
			if qname != nil && noSideEffectExterns.Contains(qname) && !isDefinedInSrc {
				problemNodes.Add(n)
				if report {
					msg := "The result of the extern function call '" + qname + "' is not being used."
					t.Report(n, USELESS_CODE_ERROR, msg)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// Protect side-effect free nodes by making them parameters to a extern function call. This call
// will be removed after all the optimizations passes have run.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckSideEffects.java:147
func (c *CheckSideEffects) protectSideEffects() {
	if !problemNodes.IsEmpty() {
		if !preserveFunctionInjected {
			AddExtern(compiler)
		}
		for _, n := range problemNodes {
			name := IR.Name(PROTECTOR_FN).Srcref(n)
			name.PutBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME, true)
			replacement := IR.Call(name).Srcref(n)
			replacement.PutBooleanProp(Node.FREE_CALL, true)
			n.ReplaceWith(replacement)
			replacement.AddChildToBack(n)
			compiler.ReportChangeToEnclosingScope(replacement)
		}
	}
}

// Injects JSCOMPILER_PRESEVE into the synthetic externs
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckSideEffects.java:165
func AddExtern(compiler *Compiler) {
	c.NodeUtil.CreateSynthesizedExternsSymbol(compiler, PROTECTOR_FN)
}

// Remove side-effect sync functions.
// Inner class CheckSideEffects.StripProtection — ported as CheckSideEffectsStripProtection.
type CheckSideEffectsStripProtection struct {
	Compiler *Compiler
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckSideEffects.java:5
func (c *CheckSideEffectsStripProtection) StripProtection(compiler *Compiler) {
	c.compiler = compiler
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckSideEffects.java:10
func (c *CheckSideEffectsStripProtection) Process(externs *rhino.Node, root *rhino.Node) {
	c.NodeTraversal.Traverse(compiler, root, this)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckSideEffects.java:15
func (c *CheckSideEffectsStripProtection) Visit(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) {
	if n.IsCall() {
		target := n.GetFirstChild()
		if !target.IsName() {
			return
		}
		if target.GetString().Equals(J2CL_PROTECTOR_FN) {
			CheckState(J2clSourceUtils.IsJ2clSource(n.GetSourceFileName()), "Only allowed for J2CL code")
			NodeUtil.DeleteFunctionCall(n, compiler)
			return
		}
		if target.GetString().Equals(PROTECTOR_FN) {
			expr := n.GetLastChild()
			n.DetachChildren()
			n.ReplaceWith(expr)
			t.ReportCodeChange()
		}
	}
}

// Get fully qualified function names which are marked with @nosideeffects
// 
// <p>TODO(ChadKillingsworth) Add support for object literals
// Inner class CheckSideEffects.GetNoSideEffectExterns — ported as CheckSideEffectsGetNoSideEffectExterns.
type CheckSideEffectsGetNoSideEffectExterns struct {
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckSideEffects.java:3
func (c *CheckSideEffectsGetNoSideEffectExterns) Visit(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) {
	if n.IsFunction() {
		jsDoc := NodeUtil.GetBestJSDocInfo(n)
		if jsDoc != nil && jsDoc.IsNoSideEffects() {
			name := NodeUtil.GetName(n)
			noSideEffectExterns.Add(name)
		}
	}
	if n.IsName() && PROTECTOR_FN.Equals(n.GetString()) {
		preserveFunctionInjected = true
	}
}
